title: More control over text generation
summary:
More control over text sampling, a clearer SillyTavern listing, and sturdier request handling across the APIs.

Text requests now pass `temperature`, `top_p`, `presence_penalty`, and `frequency_penalty` through to compatible providers. Values supplied in a request take precedence over model defaults, giving developers more control over the output.

The project lists now include SillyTavern and describe its existing use of Pollinations for both text and image generation. The integration itself did not change.

Shared authentication and queue handling brings more consistent behavior across text and image requests. Invalid tokens now return a 401 error instead of crashing the text server; token validation and queue decisions were also tightened up.

highlights.title: Tune text sampling
highlights.text: Set `temperature`, `top_p`, `presence_penalty`, and `frequency_penalty` in text requests to shape the output. Supplied values take precedence over model defaults. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
